summary.en: Make your material choice work with your design, from surface colour to panel thickness.
summary.zh: 从表面花色到板材厚度，围绕设计需求选择材料。

description.en:
Explore melamine-faced MDF for furniture and interior material schedules. With 9, 12, 15 and 18 mm options listed, you can compare the thickness and decorative finish together.
Share the intended use and environment so the appropriate grade can be confirmed before ordering.
description.zh:
面向家具与室内项目，提供9、12、15及18mm三聚氰胺饰面密度板选项，可同时核对厚度和装饰表面。
请说明实际用途及环境，以便在下单前确认相应等级。

en: 1220 × 2440 mm sheets for a clearly defined material schedule.
Decor and branding options discussed against your order.
Review samples before confirming a production specification.
zh: 1220×2440mm标准幅面，方便核对材料清单。
花色与标识要求按订单沟通。
通过样品确认表面，再确定生产规格。

applications.en: Furniture, cabinetry and interior components where the specified MDF grade is appropriate. Confirm cutting, edging and environmental requirements.
applications.zh: 家具、柜体及室内部件，具体适用性以对应MDF等级为准。请确认开料、封边与环境要求。

value.zh: 木质纤维基材，等级按型号确认
三聚氰胺饰面，花色按订单确认

value.en: 20GP or 40HQ container; loading plan to confirm
Listed 40HQ order: typically 20–35 days; start date and schedule to confirm
value.zh: 已列明40HQ订单通常20–35天，具体起算条件及排产另行确认

value.en: 10 × 10 or 20 × 30 cm; 1–3 pieces; 1–5 days preparation. No sample charge; shipping to confirm.
value.zh: 10×10或20×30cm，1–3块，准备1–5天。小样免费，运费另行确认。

value.en: 200+ sheets per colour; overall order minimum applies
value.zh: 同花色200张起，整单仍须满足订单起订条件
